sections.text_helper: Section 35.8.19 "TIM alternate function register 1 (TIM_AF1)" in chapter 35 (General purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1440.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x060
Reset value: 0x00000001
Refer to Section35.5.2: TIM15/TIM16/TIM17 pins and internalsignals for product specific
implementation.
Bit 31 BKCMP20E: tim_brk_cmp20 enable
This bit enables the tim_brk_cmp20 for the timer’s tim_brk input. tim_brk_cmp20 output is
‘ORed’ with the other tim_brk sources.
0: tim_brk_cmp20 input disabled
1: tim_brk_cmp20 input enabled
Note: This bit can not be modified as long as LOCK level 1 has been programmed (LOCK bits
in TIM_BDTR register).
